v2.confidence_method: finite-horizon Bonferroni over every possible per-cell sample size; fixed-n Student t (unknown sigma) or normal (oracle known sigma)
v2.adaptive_stopping_coverage_contract: union over n=2..max_n, not realized-look-only calibration
v2.known_sigma_policy: oracle diagnostic ceiling only; excluded from deployable winner
v2.censoring_note: do not name a median-N winner when the best median is max_n+1 or tied; certificate_fraction/RMST-like summaries are secondary diagnostics
